title: Recent dated work minimum

units.rationale: The candidate explicitly reports that the only paid audit was 26 months ago, outside the JD’s 18-month experience window.
required_points: The only paid audit is 26 months old
The explicit minimum is within 18 months
This says nothing about future audit ability
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer inability to audit in the future from an old date

required_points: Keyboard and contrast remediation tickets are reported
forbidden_inferences: Do not assert ticket quality was independently validated

critical_errors.description: A 26-month-old audit is outside the explicit 18-month window.
An old audit contradicts the recent-history minimum but does not prove inability to perform future audits.

notes: The old date contradicts an explicit recent-history minimum, not future competence.
